admission.justification: Spans task schema (consolidation_list.py), worklist/gate evaluation (knowledge_worklist/consolidation.py), and writer shape admission (worklist_checks.py), guarded by consolidation pass tests.

applicability: Task document consolidationList schema, leaf worklist computation, writer worklist shape checks, and closeout gate evaluation.
conditions: consolidationList ({families, rules}) lives only on task documents (not masters), is classified as a LIFECYCLE field, and raises one deduplicated consolidation_target item per listed family and reached rule beside ordinary worklist items.
Writer worklist shape checks admit consolidation_target string facts.record values, and the closeout gate holds until every listed and reached consolidation_target item is closed.
exclusions: Unlisted unchanged memory records, which raise no consolidation_target items.

evidence: test_consolidation_pass.py (including test_persisted_consolidation_target_worklist_passes_writer_shape_check) and sbx-e8 Evidence 8 live runs on SBX-C1-L1 and SBX-C1-L2.

statement: A consolidation leaf task document stores consolidationList ({families, rules}) as a LIFECYCLE field, raises exactly one consolidation_target worklist item per listed family and reached rule beside ordinary worklist items, admits consolidation_target in writer worklist shape checks, and holds the closeout gate until every listed and reached item is closed.
title: consolidationList LIFECYCLE field, consolidation_target worklist and gate
